subject: Physics
q: A 1 m long organ pipe, open at both ends, contains a gas whose density is twice that of air at STP. If the speed of sound in air at STP is 300 m/s, find in hertz the difference between the second-harmonic frequency and the fundamental frequency of the pipe. Give the nearest integer.
hint: At the same pressure, sound speed varies inversely as the square root of density; for an open pipe, f_n = nv/(2L).
solution: The gas has speed v = 300/√2 = 150√2 m/s. For an open pipe, f₂ - f₁ = v/L - v/(2L) = v/(2L). With L = 1 m, the difference is 75√2 ≈ 106.07 Hz, whose nearest integer is 106.
